components.role_description: Number of elements in the array

constraints.name: valid_pair_definition
constraints.description: A pair of indices {i, j} with i != j is considered valid if a[i] + a[j] > 0. The pair is unordered, meaning {i, j} and {j, i} are the same pair and counted only once.
constraints.formal: For i ≠ j, pair {i, j} is valid if and only if a[i] + a[j] > 0; each unordered pair is counted exactly once.

objective.description: 统计数组中所有满足两数之和大于0的无序对(i, j)的数量

invariants.name: sorted_sequence
invariants.description: The array is sorted in non-decreasing order, which stabilizes the comparison behavior and allows bulk counting of pairs.

invariants.name: monotonic_index_progression
invariants.description: The two indices i and j move monotonically towards each other (i only increases, j only decreases), ensuring each element is considered as endpoint exactly once and the search space shrinks correctly.

invariants.name: threshold_transitivity
invariants.description: When the sum of the smallest and largest remaining elements exceeds zero, the sorted order guarantees that all pairs formed by the largest element with any element from i to j-1 also exceed zero, enabling O(1) addition of j-i valid pairs.

original_problem.description:
Given an array of size N, find the number of distinct pairs {i, j} (i != j) in the array such that the sum of a[i] and a[j] is greater than 0.
Example 1:
Input: N = 3, a[] = {3, -2, 1}
Output: 2
Explanation: {3, -2}, {3, 1} are two 
possible pairs.
Example 2:
Input: N = 4, a[] = {-1, -1, -1, 0}
Output: 0
Explanation: There are no possible pairs.
Your Task:  
You don't need to read input or print anything. Complete the function ValidPair() which takes the array a[ ] and size of array N as input parameters and returns the count of such pairs.
Expected Time Complexity: O(N * Log(N))
Expected Auxiliary Space: O(1)
Constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 10^{5} 
-10^{4}  ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^{4}
